title: U.S.-Canada Trade War: What to Know About Tariffs and the Negotiations
summary: Canada suspended trade negotiations, triggering President Trump’s 50 percent tariffs on a range of Canadian goods. Mark Carney said he would retaliate “dollar for dollar.”
